glands in the BOTTOM of the enclosure only (washdown):
M25 x 2 (supply, motor W-M1), M20 x 5 (W-M2, W-F1, W-P04, W-P07, W-P30)
22 mm holes Ø22.3; legend plates engraved
Enclosure 24 x 20 x 8 in, 304 SS, NEMA 4X, with back panel and
Disconnect switch 40 A 3-pole, door handle, lockable
Fuse Class J 35 A time delay
Fuse holder Class J 30/60 A 2-pole, indicating
VFD 2 HP 230 V 1/3-ph input, STO, RS-485 Modbus

Fuse holder + 4 A fuse, 24 V distribution
Safety relay 24 V DC, 3 NO safety + 1 NC aux, manual monitored
Run seal-in relay 24 V DC 2 CO with socket
Valve interposing relay 24 V DC 1 CO with socket
E-stop 40 mm mushroom, turn release, 2 NC + legend
Push button green flush START 1 NO
Pilot light green RUN 24 V LED
Pilot light red FAULT 24 V LED
Terminal blocks (feed-through, ground, fused, 2-level) and end
DIN rail, wire duct 40 x 60, cable glands M20/M25 SS, ferrules
NS 35/7.5; Panduit G2X3; Lapp SKINTOP MS-SC
VFD motor cable 4 x 14 AWG shielded, 600 V, oil res., 4 m
Thermistor cable 2 x 18 AWG shielded, 4 m
Interlock and level cable 8 x 20 AWG shielded, washdown, 6 m
Plant I/O cable 12 x 20 AWG shielded to the line PLC panel, 15
RS-485 cable 1 pair shielded 120 Ω, 15 m
1. Build to UL 508A practice: SCCR label, wire 75 °C Cu, ferrules on all stranded ends, green/yellow earth to the PE bar, door earth strap.
2. Mount the panel on the two frame rails P1-301-410 with the Hoffman foot kit; top of panel at 1,505 [59.25] above the floor, gauges/lamps at eye level for the operator on the drive end.

3. Keep the VFD heat sink vertical with 100 [4] clear above and below; the enclosure needs no fan at 1.5 kW (≈ 60 W loss) in a 25 °C room: confirm with the Hoffman thermal calculator for the room temperature.
